crossRefs.note: I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and it will happen that when you go, you shall not go…
But every woman shall ask of her neighbor, and of her who visits her house, jewels of silver, jewels of gold, and…
Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man ask of his neighbor, and every woman of her neighbor, jewels of…
Yahweh gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover, the man Moses was very great in the land of…
I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth;
He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: The children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they asked of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing.
translations.bsb: Furthermore, the Israelites acted on Moses’ word and asked the Egyptians for articles of silver and gold, and for clothing.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:
translations.asv: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they asked of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment.
